issue.body:
Part of #625.

## Outcome

Lock the command replacement denominator and expose the v3 one-binary CLI shell needed before #505 can close.

## Scope

- Define the 21 current v2 installed binary denominator.
- Mark the two already-covered v3 construction surfaces (`foundation` and `local`).
- Define the remaining 19 command-equivalent routes and their mapping into one `csdlc` binary.
- Add a machine-readable command-surface manifest and CLI help/proof tests.
- Ensure unsupported live-authority routes fail closed until their implementation issues land.

## Acceptance criteria

- One machine-readable v3 command denominator exists and is reviewed.
- `csdlc --help` exposes the one-binary shape.
- Tests prove every denominator route is present or explicitly fail-closed.
- The mapping distinguishes command-surface presence from live authority.
- No v2 source changes.

## Non-goals

- Do not implement every command's full behavior in this issue.
- Do not merge or close #505.
- Do not route live lifecycle work through v3 before cutover.
